learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: Shopify, 35 products (29 pre-rolls with 1g / 5 x 0.5g / 14 x 0.5g variants, 6 vapes). product_type, tags, vendor and SKUs carry nothing.
notes: One catalog for California and New York with no state split (no tag, collection or page per state); the footer carries a CA licence and NY OCM processor licence OCM-PROC-25-000251. Checked 2026-10-05: 6 of the 8 products two or more NY stores sell are on it.

Titles are the strain only; the size is the variant ('1 gram Pre-Roll', '5 x 0.5 gram Pre-Rolls', '14 x 0.5 gram Pre-Rolls'). sizes.py reads '5 x 0.5 gram' as 0.5g (its pack pattern wants 'g' right after the number), so the rules extract the count and unit weight from the variant with the unit split off ('5 x 0.5' + 'g' is 5pk 2.5g).

The line is only collection membership: /collections/bubble-hash-infused (all titled 'Flower x Hash', so ' x ' in the title marks them) and /collections/triple-infused, whose six products only two mention in their copy. Those six are listed by handle; a new triple-infused product gets the line only if its copy says 'Triple Infused', so compare with /collections/triple-infused/products.json when the catalog changes.

The six vapes (/collections/extracts: 'Pink Runtz', 'Grapeness Extract', 'Sour Diesel' at handle sour-diesel-vape ...) have one 'Default Title' variant and no size in the copy, so they are skipped; stores list them as 1g carts, but too few stores to confirm (2026-10-05).
